# Border Width

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Border Width

The border property syntax is:

```css
border: width style color;
```

The first value here specifies the thickness of the border.

Example

```html
1<h1>Sneakers on Sale</h1>
2<p>Step up your game with these trendy, ultra-comfortable sneakers designed for both performance and style. Perfect for casual wear or a workout!</p>
3<a href="#">Buy Now</a>
```

```css
1a {
2    background-color: #6603fc;
3    color: #ffffff;
4    text-decoration: none;
5
6    /* Border styling */
7    border: 2px solid #ff0000;
8}
```

Browser Output

![Border Width](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, the button has a border of 2px width.
